page.overview:
What is Breadfan?

Breadfan is the eighth track from 1998's album Garage, Inc. second disc. It was written by Burke Shelley, Tony Bourge, and Ray Phillips, with a length of 5:41.

Originally released by Budgie in 1973 on the Never Turn Your Back on a Friend album, Metallica have already released their version in their 1988's Harvester of Sorrow single. It is also featured in the Eye of the Beholder and One singles.

Breadfan Open up your mind Open up your purse Open up your vault Never, never gonna lose it

Breadfan Take it all away Never give an inch Gotta make a mint Gotta make me a million
